# Praxis

Praxis is a warm, dark-first palette with a light-mode fallback and a true-black variant. It uses compact Fibonacci-based spacing and adds Minimal-compatible helper classes, card and gallery layouts, image grids and filters, custom task icons, varied callout styles and quiet Properties styling. A lightweight stylesheet for Obsidian Publish is included.

![Praxis screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/voi-tech/obsidian-praxis/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Praxis"
    author: "voitech"
    repo:   "voi-tech/obsidian-praxis"
    slug:   "praxis"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/praxis"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/voi-tech/obsidian-praxis"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/voi-tech/obsidian-praxis/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a warm, dark-first palette with a light-mode fallback and a true-black variant for focused, readable editing. Use compact Fibonacci-based spacing, Minimal-compatible helper classes, card and gallery layouts, image grids and filters, custom task icons, varied callout styles, quiet Properties styling, and a lightweight Obsidian Publish stylesheet."
}
```
